laws.name: Law of Hidden Laws (Completeness Impossibility)
laws.detection_logic: Unknown failure classes must emit HOLE, never safe-pass.

laws.name: Law of Future Mutation (Temporal Robustness)
laws.detection_logic: Regime shifts must trigger re-check and bounded claims.

laws.name: Law That Creates Laws (Adaptive Law Formation)
laws.detection_logic: Novel recurring patterns synthesize new enforceable law.

laws.name: No Repeat Without New Constraint Coverage
laws.detection_logic: Repeated novelty without new coverage is illegal.

laws.name: Authenticated Updates Only
laws.detection_logic: Planet manifest updates require signed ledger-linked proof.

laws.name: Strict Improvement After Shock
laws.detection_logic: Coverage must improve after novelty shock.
